title: AURLens snapshot verification report, schema version 1
description: The document printed by `aurlens verify PATH --snapshot-digest HEX --json`. Every listed property is always present. A later release may add properties without changing `schema_version`, so consumers must ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: The version of this report format.

operation.description: Identifies the document as a verification report.

status.description: Whether the checkout matches the supplied digest. A match is not a review decision.

exit_code.description: The process exit status: 0 for matched, 3 for changed or incomplete.

expected_digest.description: The supplied digest, exactly as given. It can be malformed if the status is incomplete.

snapshot_digest.description: The captured digest, or null if capture failed or did not start.

issues.description: Stable failure codes. Empty on a match.

notice.description: Explains the distinction between a match and execution approval.
